description: Testing of operational resilience and system recovery capabilities is not conducted. This signal indicates that recovery procedures may fail during actual incidents.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring operational assurance. Includes disaster recovery testing, failover exercises, and resilience validation.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through resilience testing records, DR exercise verification, and recovery capability assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
